issue: Matcher treats every repeated exact INSPIRE ID occurrence as ambiguity although HMLR officially duplicates boundary polygons across local-authority files.
required_patch: Retain raw exact-ID occurrences with source path and source SHA.
Normalize candidate geometries in EPSG:27700 and compute stable topological/normalized geometry identity.
Group repeated exact-ID occurrences by equivalent normalized geometry.
Allow success only when unique_geometry_match_count==1 and point-relation evidence is consistent; retain every duplicate source receipt.
Block when same ID maps to materially different geometries or inconsistent point relation.
Do not deduplicate by raw WKB alone; ring orientation/serialization differences must not create false ambiguity.
